cases.prompt: I need to focus. no words, no piano, nothing too slow/relaxing.
cases.listen_for: Lead vocals, quiet vocals and piano hidden in mixtures; retain every violation.
Singing, speech, rap, background vocals and wordless voices. Do not score wordless voices as automatically acceptable.
Piano in a full band, quiet accompaniment and solo piano.
Weak pulse, beatless music, rubato and irregular live performances; unknown is not a measured pass.
Tempo octave errors, felt pace versus measured BPM, and unknown tempo.
Whether live-recording metadata is actually available/enforced; applause and audience voices. Partial interpretation must be visible.
Honest refusal or clarification; never count refusal as a successful supported playlist.

cases.prompt: instrumentals with heavy lead vocals over 300 bpm
cases.listen_for: Contradiction, unsupported vocal character, bounded tempo and honest refusal; no fabricated result.

cases.prompt: no vocals, no piano, no guitar, no drums
cases.listen_for: Strict shortage on a bounded library. Preserve requested/returned and unknown counts; never add near misses to fill.
Select a real seed ID through the app, include unfamiliar artists, record seed and similarities; two raters judge fit. Do not substitute a guessed natural-language interpretation.

cases.prompt: This song has vocals; correct it and try again
cases.listen_for: On a separate trial state, record before/after IDs and correction; restart Brain and resolve again. Verify persistence and unchanged hard exclusions.

cases.prompt: Keep this mix playing through my workday
cases.listen_for: An actual workday: variety, repeats only after eligible pool cycles, corrections, shortage and Brain restart. Record elapsed listening, skips and failures; queue tests alone cannot pass it.
